press_references.value: Transparency is never partisan, especially with tax money involved

legal_proceedings.description: Iowa State Auditor Rob Sand criticizes the lack of transparency and financial controls in the administration of education savings accounts, which are expected to cost $344 million in the 2025-2026 school year. Sand's attempts to audit the program have been blocked by Governor Kim Reynolds and state officials, leading to accusations of political bias.

identifier.value: Odyssey Education Savings Account (ESA) and Microgrant Management Platform

product.name: Odyssey Education Savings Account (ESA) and Microgrant Management Platform
product.description: A platform that manages education savings accounts and microgrant programs, handling applications, payments, and customer support for states, parents, and vendors.

product.name: Odyssey Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace where parents can browse and purchase educational products and services using state funds through ESA or microgrant programs.

product.name: Application Processing and Verification System
product.description: A system that enables parents to apply for education savings accounts or microgrants, with rapid verification and approval processes.

identifier.value: Program Administration and Customer Support Services

product.name: Program Administration and Customer Support Services
product.description: Comprehensive management services for states including marketing, outreach, payment processing, and customer support for ESA and microgrant programs.

identifier.value: Financial Reporting and Fraud Prevention Tools

product.name: Financial Reporting and Fraud Prevention Tools
product.description: Tools that provide states with real-time financial data and mechanisms to detect and prevent fraud, waste, and abuse in ESA and microgrant programs.
